title: New-hire-focus-sprint-10day-deck-and-evidence-log
summary: Working deck + checklist to run a focused 10-day activation sprint for new engineering hires (individual contributor level). Purpose: get to first meaningful contribution, capture evidence for manager + IC onboarding review, and standardize risk mitigations for common access/infra blockers.
content:
PURPOSE
- Reduce cognitive overload by prioritizing 3 goals for days 0-10: (1) access & environment stable, (2) first small merged PR, (3) onboarding evidence log for 1:1 review.
- This doc is a hybrid: a lightweight deck to walk hiring manager + mentor through days 0-10, and an evidence log template the new hire fills out daily.

SCOPE / AUDIENCE
- Audience: hiring managers, people ops, assigned mentor, new hire.
- Scope: IC contributor roles (SWE I/II), not managers or infra-only hires. Adjust tasks for PMs/designers.

PRE-START (2 weeks before day 0)
- Manager: confirm repo access, test account, dev VM allocation, Slack invites.
- People Ops: confirm offer signed, start equipment order (laptop + adapter + monitor), set start day calendar, create onboarding ticket HR-ACCESS-<candidate>.
- Mentor: prepare 2 small starter tasks and local dev readme.

10-DAY SPRINT (high level)
Day 0: welcome + logistics (HR intro, manager 30m, mentor 30m), equipment check, accounts verification.
Day 1: environment setup, run app locally, pair with mentor on starter task A.
Day 2: complete starter task A; open PR + request review.
Day 3: shadow code reviews, do small bugfix B.
Day 4: merge starter PR, write short self-reflection entry in evidence log.
Day 5: cross-team intro (product/infra), identify first project scope.
Day 6: begin first scoped ticket C with mentor check-ins.
Day 7: mid-sprint sync with manager (15m) + mentor feedback.
Day 8: continue ticket C, draft acceptance criteria and test plan.
Day 9: submit PR for ticket C, coordinate reviews.
Day 10: post-sprint demo (10m), evidence log review, 30-day ramp goals set.

EXPECTED DELIVERABLES BY DAY 10
- Merged starter PR (or PR with active reviewer comments if blocked).
- Evidence log with daily entries (see template below).
- Manager + mentor signoff (email or Slack).
- 30-day goals doc created.

EVIDENCE LOG TEMPLATE (to be filled daily by new hire)
- Date, time-blocks worked, top 3 wins, top 3 blockers (with owner tags), 1 learning note, 1 question for manager. Keep entries ~3-6 lines.

INTERVIEW RUBRIC (used at offer -> alignment to onboarding)
- Role fit: technical fundamentals (4-point scale), system design baseline (3-point scale for IC1), communication & signal (4-point).
- Practical: candidate provided repo walkthrough or code sample -> used to create starter tasks that match strengths.
- Hiring note: if candidate scored <2 on fundamentals, plan extended ramp (21-day) + weekly paired programming.

SCORING GUIDANCE (for quick handoffs)
- 4 (Exceeds) = independent with minimal context, finds edge cases, mentors others.
- 3 (Meets) = completes core tasks, asks clarifying Qs, predictable velocity.
- 2 (Borderline) = needs defined tasks, sometimes blocked on environment.
- 1 (Insufficient) = unable to complete simple debugging or local run within expected window.

HIRING PLAN ATTACHMENT (manager checklist)
- Role brief: 1-paragraph core responsibilities + 3 measurable signals of success in first 90 days.
- Interview loop: 3 technical interviews (coding + systems + culture) + 1 hiring manager screen + take-home optional.
- Interviewer roster: include mentor + peer reviewer names and backup interviewers.
- Offer-to-start timeline: aim 2 weeks between signed offer and start; if >3 weeks, schedule a 1:1 prestart sync.

ONBOARDING RISK LOG (quick mitigation patterns)
- Common blocker: Mismatched SSH keys / VPN -> mitigation: envoy-guides + mentor test step day -1.
- Common blocker: delayed laptop delivery -> mitigation: loaner laptop + remote pairing until device arrives.
- Common blocker: missing cloud roles (devops perms) -> mitigation: manager escalates to infra + attach temporary CI token.

COMMUNICATION TEMPLATES (short snippets)
- Slack: "@mentor Hi! I'm grouped onto starter task A — running into X on setup; can you check my env?"
- Manager check-in: "Quick FYI: candidate hit merged PR on D4, backlog ticket C opened for D6–D9."

MEASUREMENT / SUCCESS METRICS (first 10 days)
- % employees with merged starter PR by day 7 (target 80%).
- Median days to first merged PR (target <= 6 days).
- % hires with full dev environment by day 1 (target 95%).
- Qualitative: manager confidence rating at day 10 (scale 1–5).

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / DECISIONS
- Should we require starter PR merged by D7 for all IC1 hires or allow exceptions? (need input from eng leads).
- Is evidence log private to manager+hire or shared to people ops? current leaning: manager+hire only, people ops aggregate anonymized signals.
- How to handle part-time contractors (expect longer ramp): propose 21-day variation.

REFERENCES / LINKS
- Confluence onboarding checklist (linked_artifacts).
- HR equipment order playbook.

NOTES TO SELF (working doc style)
- Keep checklist short — onboarding fatigue is real.
- Ask SRE for a Bryan-style runbook for VPN flaps.
- Try one cohort pilot (n=6 hires) for Q2 to measure metrics above.

APPENDIX: QUICK MENTOR GUIDE (1-page)
- Day 0: 30m intro (project context + code map).
- Day 1–3: pair on starter tasks, give bite-sized PR comments.
- Day 4–10: move from pairing to async reviews; highlight one learning area each day.

END OF DOC
checklist: Create equipment order 7 days before start
Confirm repo + cloud access 3 days before start
Mentor prepares starter tasks and README 3 days before start
Loaner laptop plan in case of delivery delays
Daily evidence log reminder set (automated slack DM)
Day10 demo slot reserved on manager calendar
interview_rubric: Technical fundamentals: 1-4 (code correctness, clarity, test hygiene)
Collaboration & communication: 1-4 (asks clarifying Qs, receives feedback)
Autonomy signal: binary note (requires >50% guidance vs independent)
hiring_plan_timeline: Week -2: confirm offer package & equipment start
Week -1: mentor assigned, starter tasks drafted
